themes.title: Notification overload has trained users to stop reading notifications
themes.summary: Getting an email for every comment/status-change/mention created so much noise the participant stopped reading notifications entirely within a couple months, relying on direct Slack pings instead.
supporting_quotes: I get an email for literally everything... my inbox is just noise at this point, so honestly I stopped reading them.
I only find out about important stuff when someone pings me directly in Slack

themes.title: Notification settings lack per-project and per-type granularity
themes.summary: Existing controls are all-or-nothing per category, with no way to set different notification rules for different projects based on priority.
supporting_quotes: I can turn off "all comment notifications" but I can't say "only notify me on comments where I'm mentioned."
My high-priority client project should notify me on everything, but my internal admin board can just be a weekly summary.

pain_points.description: Email notifications fire for every event type (comments, status changes, mentions) with no filtering, causing users to disengage entirely.
pain_points.quote: I get an email for literally everything... so honestly I stopped reading them.

pain_points.description: Notification settings only support all-or-nothing toggles per category, not granular rules like mention-only.
In-app notification bell shows the same unfiltered firehose as email, with no priority or type filtering.
pain_points.quote: it shows the same firehose as email, just in a different place

action_items.rationale: Directly requested; addresses the core cause of notification fatigue.

action_items.action: Support per-project notification rules (e.g. real-time for high-priority projects, weekly digest for low-priority ones).
action_items.rationale: Matches how the user actually prioritizes different projects.

action_items.action: Add filtering/prioritization to the in-app notification bell, not just email.
action_items.rationale: In-app notifications currently offer no advantage over the broken email experience.
